title: What if everyone shared the same thoughts?

lines.text: What if everyone shared the same thoughts?
It starts on an ordinary morning. You step out of the café, think coffee, and every head on the street thinks it too. One mind. Eight billion people.
By mid-morning there are no secrets. The lie you were about to tell dies before you say it. Nobody argues, because everyone already knows how it ends.
By noon the city moves like one body. Traffic flows without a single light. The crowd walks in step. And the silence is strange.
By sunset you notice what's missing. No surprises. No jokes, because everyone knows the punchline. Every song in your head is the same song.
At night, the one thought turns dark. One fear spreads in a second. One nightmare, eight billion sleepers.
So, would you keep the one mind, or fight for your own?
